text: # Ten substantial findings

User direction, 2026-10-08: “Perfect. Keep progress until you got 10.” Resumed 2026-10-09: “Now keep proceed for 10 target”. This continues the substantial-discovery standard used for R006 and R008. Target: **10 total; 8 accepted, 2 remaining; research active**. The historical F001–F010 and technical R001–R005/R007 do not enter this count.

**Historical pause, 2026-10-08:** “Let’s pause after 4th finding for now.” R010 passed all acceptance gates and the work was paused with partial artifacts preserved. **The user explicitly resumed on 2026-10-09**, then instructed: “also after the verification commit & push to the public repo”. The old pause restriction is revoked. Each newly accepted finding still receives its own commit. The user selected publication of **only `openai-proof-research`** to `https://github.com/mjkang-estrella/math`. Public history is filtered to this directory; unrelated local research is excluded. Filtering changes commit identifiers while retaining separate commits.
## Resumed work, 2026-10-09

- I14: [final significance review](reviews/i14-spectral-width-novelty-r3.md) completed: **TECHNICAL ONLY**, proof PASS retained. Parent verification agrees with its reduction to known local estimates and the source's global construction. No count increment.

- I15: [final significance review](reviews/i15-odd-order-topology-novelty-r3.md) gives **TECHNICAL ONLY**, preserving full-theorem proof PASS. The marked construction is an iteration of an explicit source-proof operation, with unchanged downstream interfaces. No exact duplicate or new proof gap is claimed; no count increment.

- I17: [final significance review](reviews/i17-six-point-ramsey-novelty-r3.md) recommends **TECHNICAL ONLY**, retaining full proof PASS without repairs. The six-point certificate reduces to the source's adjugate lifting applied twice and multiplication. No exact duplicate or new gap is claimed; no count increment.

- I18: the [joint prime-neighbor report](iterations/i18-joint-prime-neighbors.md) is complete as a scoped gap report. Restricted classical laws and a presieve input are proved; the full mixed prime discrepancy remains unproved. No count increment.

- I19: the [structural report](iterations/i19-fresh-structural-discovery.md) proves a technical signed Saxl quotient and identifies its narrow-partition gap; two other screens yield an unresolved unimodality route and a weighted-switch counterexample. No substantial finding is proposed.

- I20: the [kinetic report](iterations/i20-pde-kinetic-discovery.md) is a scoped gap record. It proves technical seed-count and initial-contact results, but microscopic selection, general-potential fluctuations and the dynamical mean correction remain unproved.

- I21: the [signed Saxl follow-up](iterations/i21-signed-saxl-dominance.md) constructs signed dominance maps and arbitrary-width quotients but proves specific failures of the proposed coverage. The refined conjecture remains unproved; this route is parked pending a different uniform mechanism.

- I22: the [combinatorial report](iterations/i22-combinatorial-discovery.md) retains two complete technical deductions, entropy/DP-coloring gaps, and a prior-art rejection of approximate PSD-rank strengthening. No substantial finding is proposed.

- I23: the [kinetic follow-up](iterations/i23-kinetic-connected-fluctuations.md) proves limited component and virial estimates but leaves the normalized signed-history summation gap open. No Gaussian theorem is proposed; this route is parked pending a new representation.

- I24: the [completed resumed report](iterations/i24-elementary-unimodality-resumed.md) reconstructs rational bar invariance and finiteness/centering of graph-relevant history jumps. Nonnegative character multiplicities and a suitable Lefschetz identification remain unproved, so general elementary unimodality is still open in this record. [Parent verification](experiments/i24-resumed-parent-verification.json) passes; no substantial finding is proposed.

- I25: **accepted as [R011](findings/R011-rooted-matching-entropy.md), the fifth substantial finding**. Full-proof review passes without repairs; independent significance review judges the rooted separator/global-maximum mechanism substantial. Parent reproduction and integrity checks pass. All entropy and counting consequences count once.

- I26: the [completed probability report](iterations/i26-probability-discovery-resumed.md) screens Voronoi dynamics, Ising logarithmic fluctuations and integer-height interfaces. Exact conditioning identities are technical source deductions; uniform slit-domain estimates and the scaling theorem remain unproved. [Parent verification](experiments/i26-resumed-parent-verification.json) passes; no substantial finding is proposed.

- I27: the [completed geometric report](iterations/i27-geometric-analysis-discovery.md) develops endpoint-varifold arguments and explicit countermodels, but rectifiability, original-metric Einstein stability and spatial-Lp Ricci-flow continuation remain unproved. [Parent verification](experiments/i27-parent-verification.json) passes; no count increment.

- I28: the [completed algebra report](iterations/i28-algebra-discovery.md) supplies a technical filtered-persistence argument, but an obstructed nonconical ring remains unconstructed. Ulam and involutive-division-ring screens retain specific obstructions. [Parent verification](experiments/i28-parent-verification.json) passes as a gap record; no count increment.

- I29: [completed common-base entropy report](iterations/i29-common-base-entropy.md) proves the sharp all-mean bound H_C≥F−(1−1/r)B through the source tight-chain rank and covariance trace operations. Boundary reduction, weighted Gibbs scope and explicit gluing/log-concavity/root-reserve obstructions are included. Classified technical only; parent isolated reproduction and seven PDF replays pass. No count increment.

- I30: the [original-metric GH theorem](iterations/i30-einstein-metric-stability.md), with bound C D^(1/16), retains [full-proof PASS](reviews/i30-einstein-metric-stability-r2.md) but is **TECHNICAL ONLY** after [final significance review](reviews/i30-einstein-metric-stability-novelty-r3.md). Clarke's Lemma 12 supplies the exact square-root-volume refinement, and Tian–Wang supplies the distance construction. Parent reproduction passes; no exact full-scope duplicate or new gap is claimed. No count increment.

- I31: [nonconical no-MCM realization](iterations/iteration31-nonconical-no-mcm-task.json) suffered a provider failure before a report. The parent verified and preserved its preparation; the [same delegated task resumed](iterations/iteration31-nonconical-resume.json) to finish the I28 audit and attempt the missing construction. Its deformation idea remains unverified; no count increment.

- I32: the [completed geometric/relativity report](iterations/i32-geometric-relativity-discovery.md) develops a technical fixed-p>1 Kerr deduction and two approaches to the unresolved LlogL endpoint, with precise smooth examples and separate Penrose/transport gaps. Parent reproduction passes; no independent proof acceptance or substantial nomination.

- I33: the [completed Brenier report](iterations/i33-density-robust-brenier.md) supplies a smooth three-cell obstruction to the weighted-moment bridge and uniform linear potential estimate, plus a technical cube-root map bound retaining atom-count dependence. [I34's independent audit](iterations/i34-target-uniform-brenier.md) passes both deductions without mathematical repairs. No substantial nomination.

- I34: the [completed report](iterations/i34-target-uniform-brenier.md) develops actual many-cell and entropic examples, a uniform two-atom bias bound, and precise remaining gaps. The full target-uniform map theorem remains unproved and not refuted. Parent checks pass; I35 independently passes the entropic interfaces it uses without mathematical repairs.

- I35: the [completed splitting-invariant report](iterations/i35-splitting-invariant-entropic-bias.md) develops cluster comparisons, source-slice quantiles and restricted uniform Gibbs bias bounds. General bias UB and map stability Q remain unproved and not refuted. The transverse-redistribution lemma TR is explicitly equivalent to UB up to variance constants, not an established weaker premise. Parent reproduction passes; transport is parked pending a new mechanism for TR. No substantial nomination.

- I36: the [common geometric-avoidance theorem](iterations/i36-harmonic-analysis-discovery.md) retains [independent full-proof PASS without repairs](reviews/i36-common-geometric-avoidance-r2.md), but the [final significance review](reviews/i36-common-geometric-avoidance-novelty-r3.md) judges it **TECHNICAL ONLY**. G/D routing combined with prior moving-window and multidimensional grid-signature operations supplies an explicit noncircular reduction. No exact theorem duplicate or new proof gap is claimed. Parent verification passes; no count increment.

- I37: [supergeometric avoidance](iterations/i37-supergeometric-avoidance.md) is a completed gap report. Its scoped routing obstruction and unpaid covering/conditional-survivor criteria do not prove or refute the target; the route is parked.

- I38: **accepted as [R012](findings/R012-uniform-gaussian-propeller-stability.md), the sixth substantial finding**. Original-proof PASS without repairs, final significance SUBSTANTIAL, and parent reproduction pass. All Gaussian propeller stability consequences count once.

- I39: [quantum/spectral discovery](iterations/i39-quantum-spectral-discovery.md) completes a developed Haldane-disorder gap report and precise SK entropy/waiting-time screens. Parent checks pass; no substantial nomination.

- I40: [critical SK waiting-time relaxation](iterations/i40-critical-sk-waiting-relaxation.md) supplies a technical Gaussian deduction; I41’s independent audit passes the original proof without repairs. Parent reproduction passes; no substantial nomination.

- I41: [Rademacher fair-start warming](iterations/i41-rademacher-fair-start-warming.md) gives a technical four-time profile comparison, now independently passed by I42 without repairs. Fair-start density tightness and full W remain unproved and unrefuted. No substantial nomination.

- I42: [completed independent audit](reviews/i42-four-time-profile-r2.md) gives PASS ORIGINAL WITHOUT REPAIRS for the profile comparison, representations, entropy criterion and scoped countermodel. Parent checks pass; the direct I41 ledger-drift failure and separate frozen-ledger replay are preserved. No count increment.

- I43: [completed convex/isoperimetric report](iterations/i43-convex-isoperimetric-discovery.md) develops two approaches to logarithmic Brunn–Minkowski equality and separate rectangular-torus/reverse-projection gaps. Exact partial results and evidence checks pass as a gap record; no independent analytic acceptance or substantial nomination.

- I44: [completed logarithmic equality report](iterations/i44-logarithmic-equality-polytopes.md) passes I43’s mathematical partials without repairs, develops facet/boundary deductions, and gives an attributed symmetric equality reduction from a newly identified external proposed proof. I45 passes its new analytic deductions and cubic stability obstruction without repairs. Parent evidence checks pass; no substantial nomination.

- I45: [completed independent audit](reviews/i45-logarithmic-equality-r2.md) gives PASS ORIGINAL WITHOUT REPAIRS for E, C, B and Q. Symmetric E is technically closed under the pinned premises, with full Liu–Sun–Xiong attribution; no nonsymmetric theorem is certified. Parent reproduction passes; no count increment.

- I46: [completed quantitative report](iterations/i46-quantitative-logarithmic-stability.md) supplies an author proof of planar Δ ≥ c d𝓔^10 with facet-independent constants. I47 passes the original proof without repairs; I48 judges the contribution **TECHNICAL ONLY** via an explicit noncircular reduction. The all-dimensional target is unproved and unrefuted. Parent evidence checks pass.

- I47: [completed independent full-proof review](reviews/i47-planar-logarithmic-stability-r2.md) gives **P10 PASS ORIGINAL WITHOUT REPAIRS**. Construction A’s partial and conditional budgets also pass, with the higher-dimensional gaps retained. Parent reproduction passes; no count increment.

- I110: [completed Galois cancellation report](iterations/i110-galois-moment-cancellation.md) passes all original I108 claims at their stated scopes without repairs; parent replay passes. New P110 reconstructs exact fixed ordinary-label counts at p=2, gcd(a,f)=1; 56 support moments vanish on six finite inputs. U110 transfers divisibility to products without a common quotient and gives v₂(N)≥s+3 uniformly for A5×A with odd-order abelian A. C110 pairs nontrivial local-point strata equivariantly, leaving the trivial stratum unpaid. These are technical partials; arbitrary TD and G104 remain unproved/unrefuted, and the branch is parked. No count increment.

- I111: [completed independent R105 audit](reviews/i111-rational-tail-attachment-r2.md) gives **ORIGINAL PASS WITHOUT REPAIRS** to all seven proof components for every p≥5 and allowed H choice, and independently confirms the technical classification. Parent evidence replay passes. No substantial nomination or count increment.

- I114: [quantum-information report](iterations/i114-quantum-information-discovery.md) gives author-level technical thermal-balance and information-loss stability bounds, scoped counterexamples and a high-precision synthesis reduction. Parent evidence replay PASS. Unequal-temperature entropy stability remains unproved/unrefuted; no count increment.

- I117: [original-proof audit and bosonic entropy continuation](iterations/iteration117-bosonic-entropy-stability-task.json) audits every I114 component before pursuing entropy-to-defect transfer and correlated-reference routes at the original fixed-energy, fixed-entropy scope. Active.
